name: jira
title: Jira
description: Browse and search your Jira issues using a Personal Access Token.
author: sujha

commands.name: list-issues
commands.title: List Jira Issues
commands.subtitle: Jira
commands.description: Show issues assigned to you / reported by you / watched / by custom JQL.

commands.name: open-issue
commands.title: Open Jira Issue in Browser
commands.subtitle: Jira
commands.description: Open the selected Jira issue key (e.g. DISE-19408) in your browser.

preferences.name: baseURL
preferences.title: Base URL
preferences.description: Your Jira base URL, e.g. https://jira.example.com

preferences.name: token
preferences.title: API Token (PAT)
preferences.description: Personal Access Token used as a Bearer token in API calls.

preferences.name: defaultJQL
preferences.title: Default JQL
preferences.description: Initial JQL used when the extension opens.
preferences.default: assignee = currentUser() ORDER BY updated DESC
preferences.placeholder: assignee = currentUser() ORDER BY updated DESC

preferences.name: maxResults
preferences.title: Max Results
preferences.description: Maximum number of issues to fetch per query (1–200).
